start.title: [TODO:tr] Setting Out
start.text:
[TODO:tr] Evening falls on the sea.
Jesus says, "Let us cross over."

refuse_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Follow His Word
refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] His call is for tonight.
Go with him.

wait_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Trust Him Now
wait_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] He waits at the shore.
Delay nothing.

storm.title: [TODO:tr] The Sea Rises
storm.text:
[TODO:tr] Wind tears the sail.
Waves crash into the boat.

curse_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Hold Steady
curse_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Cursing will not still the storm.
Row with the others.

leap_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Stay With Him
leap_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] The sea would swallow you.
Return to the boat.

sleep.title: [TODO:tr] He Sleeps
sleep.text:
[TODO:tr] Jesus sleeps in the stern.
The storm grows fiercer.

alone_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Go To Him
alone_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] You cannot save the boat alone.
Wake your Lord.

wake.title: [TODO:tr] Wake Him
wake.text:
[TODO:tr] What will you say?
The water rises fast.

blame_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Ask, Don't Blame
blame_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] He is not your enemy.
Ask him to save you.

silent_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Cry To Him
silent_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Silence will not still the sea.
Speak.

calm.title: [TODO:tr] Peace, Be Still
calm.text:
[TODO:tr] He stands and lifts his hand.
"Peace. Be still."

doubt_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] See and Believe
doubt_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] The sea is glass.
Let awe fill you.

amaze.title: [TODO:tr] Who Is This?
amaze.text:
[TODO:tr] The sea is still.
"Even the wind obeys him."
